item.title: Rainfall Advisory No. 1 #NCRPRSD
item.description:
Heavy Rainfall Warning No. 1 #NCR_PRSD
Weather System: Southwest Monsoon (Habagat)
Issued at: 8:00 PM, 16 August 2026(Sunday)

YELLOW WARNING LEVEL: Zambales.
ASSOCIATED HAZARD: Possible FLOODING in flood-prone areas.


Meanwhile, light to moderate with occasional heavy rains affecting Bataan, Tarlac, Pampanga, Nueva Ecija, Bulacan, Metro Manila, Cavite, Rizal, Batangas(Nasugbu, Lian, Calatagan, Tuy, Balayan, Calaca, Laurel, Lemery, Agoncillo, Taal, San Nicolas, Santa Teresita, San Luis, Bauan, Mabini, Talisay, Tanauan), Laguna(Calamba, Cabuyao, Santa Rosa, Binan, San Pedro, Santa Maria, Pakil, Mabitac, Famy, Siniloan, Pangil, Paete) and Quezon(General Nakar, Infanta) which may persist within 3 hours and may affect nearby areas.
The public and the Disaster Risk Reduction and Management Offices concerned are advised to MONITOR the weather condition and watch for the next warning to be issued at 11:00 PM today.
For more information and queries, please call telephone numbers 8927-1335 and 8927-2877 or log on to www.pagasa.dost.gov.ph.

item.title: Thunderstorm Advisory #NCRPRSD
item.description:
Thunderstorm Watch #NCR_PRSD
Issued at: 10:00 PM, 16 August 2026

Thunderstorm is MORE LIKELY to develop over Greater Metro Manila Area(Metro Manila, Bulacan, Rizal, Laguna and Cavite) within 12 hours.

All are advised to continue monitoring for updates.
